name: trovaprezzi
description: Trovaprezzi helps users find purchasable physical products, compare current prices and offers, and open relevant Trovaprezzi listings from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription: Trovaprezzi helps users find purchasable physical products, compare current prices and offers, and open relevant Trovaprezzi listings from a carousel widget inside ChatGPT. The app supports shopping-oriented searches for specific models, variants, availability, and budget-filtered product discovery while avoiding purely informational or non-shopping requests.
defaultPrompt: Help me find the best price for an iPhone

positive.description: Find current offers for a specific phone model family with shopping intent.
positive.prompt: Find the best prices for the iPhone 17 Pro 256GB and show me the most relevant offers.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a product carousel with purchasable iPhone 17 Pro offers, prices, and links to view offers on Trovaprezzi.

positive.description: Handle a budget-constrained laptop shopping request.
positive.prompt: I'm looking for an affordable, lightweight laptop for university. Show me options I can buy.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns budget-aware laptop results that fit the shopping request and summarizes them in the widget intro.

positive.description: Support a variant-focused availability search for a named product.
positive.prompt: Check the availability of the Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra and show me the variants I can buy.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns available Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra variants and related offers suitable for purchase comparison.

positive.description: Return a multi-item shopping set when the request spans complementary products.
positive.prompt: Put together a basic work-from-home kit with a monitor, headphones, and webcam, using specific products I can buy.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns grouped shopping results across the requested product categories instead of a single-product list.

positive.description: Respect refurbished preference in a shopping search.
positive.prompt: I'm looking for a refurbished iPhone. Show me current offers for specific models.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns refurbished-oriented product results with concrete models and current offers rather than generic advice.

negative.description: Do not trigger for requests to sell a used item.
negative.prompt: Help me sell my used car online.

negative.description: Do not trigger for non-physical-product or service requests.
negative.prompt: Recommend the best cloud storage subscription for work.

negative.description: Do not trigger for unrelated general web or travel assistance.
negative.prompt: Find a hotel in Milan for tomorrow night.

it-IT.subtitle: Confronta prezzi e offerte
it-IT.description: Trova prodotti, confronta i prezzi dei negozi e scopri le offerte pertinenti su Trovaprezzi. Cerca modelli specifici, esplora alternative in base al tuo budget e apri le schede prodotto. La disponibilità e i prezzi possono cambiare.
